_comment: Generic descriptions for well-known MCP servers, matched by the server's name in openclaw.json. Put personal/private descriptions in <openclaw-state-dir>/agent-spaghetti/catalog.local.json (not part of this repo); it overrides this file. Servers not listed here still work: ocmcp derives a summary from the package name or URL host.

github.summary: GitHub repos, issues, pull requests, code search, files

filesystem.summary: Read and write files in allowed directories

playwright.summary: Headless browser automation: navigate, click, fill forms, screenshots

chrome-devtools.summary: Chrome DevTools: performance traces, network, console, Lighthouse

brave-search.summary: Web search via Brave (the built-in web_search tool usually suffices)

context7.summary: Up-to-date library and framework documentation lookup

firebase.summary: Firebase projects, apps, security rules, deploy, SDK config

pdf-reader.summary: Read PDFs and Office documents to Markdown; search across files

pdf-reader-ocr.summary: PDF text extraction with OCR for scanned documents

excel.summary: Read and write Excel workbooks: sheets, ranges, charts, pivots

spreadsheet.summary: Query spreadsheets and CSV with SQL; read and write cells

markitdown.summary: Convert files and URLs (docx, pptx, xlsx, html, pdf) to Markdown

gsc.summary: Google Search Console: queries, indexing, sitemaps

wordpress.summary: WordPress site abilities: posts, pages, plugins
